notes: Independent solve: Q at 30° to the vertical is at 60° to the horizontal, and sin(2×30°) = sin(2×60°) = √3/2, so R_P/R_Q = u_P²/u_Q² = 1/2. Then H_P/H_Q = (u_P²/u_Q²)(sin²30°/sin²60°) = (1/2)(1/3) = 1/6. Every printed line follows. The mistake entry is correct too: leaving Q at 30° gives H_P/H_Q = 1/2, which is not printed.
